text: Give regions to another faction, demand theirs, or swap. Tick as many as you like on each side; the AI judges the whole trade. || Offering a region to a migrating tribe settles them there (only where their army stands, and never your capital). In return their attitude improves greatly.
The regions you give. Tick as many as you like. || Tick regions on the right too to ask for some in return: the AI judges the whole trade.
The regions you ask for. Tick as many as you like. || The AI values what it gives up, so the more valuable the regions, the more it wants in return.
